steps.title: Keep all of your blighted supplies …
steps.text: Keep all of your blighted supplies in your inventory for now. They will be turned into Bounty Hunter Crates later

steps.title: Head to the Grand Exchange
steps.text: Head to the Grand Exchange

steps.title: Put up a purchase order for …
steps.text: Put up a purchase order for a bond for 2m, then cancel the offer. Leave the money there

steps.title: Go to the Ferox Enclave. Don't …
steps.text: Go to the Ferox Enclave. Don't use your minigame teleport

steps.title: Put all of your remaining money …
steps.text: Put all of your remaining money in the coffer there

steps.title: Unnote some food in case you …
steps.text: Unnote some food in case you are attacked on the way to mage bank

steps.title: Grab an iron dagger from the …
steps.text: Grab an iron dagger from the spawn north of the enclave in the graveyard

steps.title: Go to the Mage Arena bank. …
steps.text: Go to the Mage Arena bank. — Use the wilderness lever to get there faster

steps.title: Collect your money from the bond …
steps.text: Collect your money from the bond at the banker

steps.title: Buy the listed runes. — 500 …
steps.text: Buy the listed runes. — 500 Mind runes — 2000 Nature runes — 1000 Cosmic runes — 800 Law runes — 1000 Water runes — 1000 Earth runes

steps.title: Return to Ferox Enclave with your …
steps.text: Return to Ferox Enclave with your minigame teleport and put all but 4000 coins into the coffer

steps.title: Chronicle teleport or home teleport, walk/canoe …
steps.text: Chronicle teleport or home teleport, walk/canoe to Varrock

steps.title: Head to Varrock
steps.text: Head to Varrock

steps.title: buy a staff of air and …
steps.text: buy a staff of air and a staff of fire

steps.title: Head to the Edgeville Dungeon and …
steps.text: Head to the Edgeville Dungeon and kill Thugs for 15 Magic and a Looting bag. — Use Wind Strike with the staff of air equipped. — Put your blighted supplies in the Looting bag once you get it.
steps.note: Fastest: enchant gem-tipped bolts (expensive). Cheaper passive: cast Low Level Alchemy from 21 while doing other things.

steps.title: Drop the mind runes after
steps.text: Drop the mind runes after

steps.title: Head to Mage Training Arena and …
steps.text: Head to Mage Training Arena and get enough points to obtain Bones to Peaches, a Rune Pouch, and a Mud Rune. — DO NOT BUY THE RUNE POUCH OR Mud Rune YET! That will come later! — Creature Graveyard: 351 points — You can drop the earth and water runes after you are done and rebuy more later. — The other reward runes are not super important. You can drop them or save them to sell/alch/use later. — Telekinetic Theatre: 351 points — Keep the air staff, or drop it for space and buy another later. — You should have some extra law runes leftover, save them for teleports. — Enchanting Chamber with Lvl-3 Enchant until you have used all of your cosmic runes. You need at least 3515 points at the end. — Alchemist's Playground until you reach 501 points. — Use up any remaining nature runes as well for extra xp. — You can deliver coins in large stacks now if you would like. There isn't a maximum anymore.

steps.title: Buy Bones to Peaches
steps.text: Buy Bones to Peaches

steps.title: Keep the staff of air
steps.text: Keep the staff of air

steps.title: Drop the staff of fire
steps.text: Drop the staff of fire

steps.title: Minigame teleport to Clan Wars to …
steps.text: Minigame teleport to Clan Wars to get your cash stack back out

steps.title: Head to Varrock and buy some …
steps.text: Head to Varrock and buy some runes: — 500 Fire Runes — 500 Earth Runes — 500 Water Runes — 20 Air runes (For Waterfall) — 500 Death Runes for Wind blast (If you run out just buy more).

steps.title: Do Daddy's Home. — Pick up …
steps.text: Do Daddy's Home. — Pick up logs in the Lumberyard to make the planks. — Complete 2 beginner Mahogany Homes contracts with the supplies. — Remember you now have a house to teleport to.

steps.title: Re-obtain your Ardougne cloak 1 for …
steps.text: Re-obtain your Ardougne cloak 1 for the teleport. — Don't forget it is relatively close to a Spirit Tree

steps.title: Get a Banana hat to improve …
steps.text: Get a Banana hat to improve your fashion

steps.title: Go pick up some Boots of …
steps.text: Go pick up some Boots of lightness from the Temple of Ikov (dungeon). — You will need a light source and a knife/slash weapon

steps.title: For the next sections, you can …
steps.text: For the next sections, you can get some cakes in Ardougne for food. — You can also buy rope and iron axe in the general store for the quests

steps.title: Head to Barbarian Assault and skip …
steps.text: Head to Barbarian Assault and skip the tutorial to unlock the minigame teleport

steps.title: While there, start Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl. …
steps.text: While there, start Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl. — The guide will take you near several of the bars in the next few steps, you can complete them as you go if you would like

steps.title: Complete Waterfall Quest until you go …
steps.text: Complete Waterfall Quest until you go to maze

steps.title: get the pebble. — Just partially …
steps.text: get the pebble. — Just partially complete it for now, you will need to clear up your bagged items before going in the tomb

steps.title: Complete Tree Gnome Village and Fight …
steps.text: Complete Tree Gnome Village and Fight Arena while in the area

steps.title: Head to any spot where you …
steps.text: Head to any spot where you can go into the Wilderness and destroy your Looting Bag to get your blighted supplies back out. — YOU MUST BE STANDING IN THE WILDERNESS OR THE ITEMS WILL BE LOST. — Obviously be safe and don't do this if anyone is nearby.

steps.title: Head to Bounty Hunter and create …
steps.text: Head to Bounty Hunter and create as many Bounty supply crates as you can

steps.title: Head to the Rogues Den
steps.text: Head to the Rogues Den

steps.title: sell the crates. — 2 per …
steps.text: sell the crates. — 2 per world is good, but it is up to you

steps.title: Drop the leftover blighted supplies
steps.text: Drop the leftover blighted supplies

steps.title: Finish Waterfall Quest. — During the …
steps.text: Finish Waterfall Quest. — During the quest, safe spot

steps.title: kill a Fire Giant for a …
steps.text: kill a Fire Giant for a combat achievement

steps.title: Complete the Natural History Quiz
steps.text: Complete the Natural History Quiz

steps.title: Minigame teleport to Fishing Trawler, buy …
steps.text: Minigame teleport to Fishing Trawler, buy a Noose wand at the Hunter shop in Yanille

steps.title: Take a Spirit Tree to Feldip …
steps.text: Take a Spirit Tree to Feldip Hills

steps.title: Hunt Feldip Weasels for 4 feldip …
steps.text: Hunt Feldip Weasels for 4 feldip weasel fur

steps.title: Head to the Fancy Clothes Store …
steps.text: Head to the Fancy Clothes Store in Varrock

steps.title: make a Jungle camo top and …
steps.text: make a Jungle camo top and Jungle camo legs. — These are storable weight reducing clothing

steps.title: Complete Priest in Peril. — Buy …
steps.text: Complete Priest in Peril. — Buy an adamant sword in Varrock. — Just make 3 trips. It isn't that big of a deal. — Briefly walk into Morytania

steps.title: Complete Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl
steps.text: Complete Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl

steps.title: Complete Scorpion Catcher. — During the …
steps.text: Complete Scorpion Catcher. — During the quest, safespot

steps.title: kill a Hellhound in the Taverly …
steps.text: kill a Hellhound in the Taverly Dungeon for a combat achievement

steps.title: Complete Merlin's Crystal if you have …
steps.text: Complete Merlin's Crystal if you have not already

steps.title: Complete Vampyre Slayer
steps.text: Complete Vampyre Slayer

steps.title: Complete Ernest the Chicken
steps.text: Complete Ernest the Chicken

steps.title: Complete Holy Grail. — Flinch the …
steps.text: Complete Holy Grail. — Flinch the boss. — You will need to briefly visit Entrana. — If you would like, you can place combat items on a table and they will stay there up to 10 minutes. There is a table upstairs in Brian's Battleaxe Bazaar. — Keep in mind that the items are still going to be visible to other players, but hopefully nobody steals them.

steps.title: You should now have 43 Prayer …
steps.text: You should now have 43 Prayer for Protect from melee

steps.title: Complete The Feud
steps.text: Complete The Feud

steps.title: Do the runes section of Rogue …
steps.text: Do the runes section of Rogue Trader. — Use the Runedoku Helper plugin. — You can now buy teleport runes from Ali Morrisane when needed without having to go to the wilderness. — Keep in mind that there a few upcoming places you will want to drop all your runes for space, so don't load up too much.
